zh-CN.name: AWS Agent 工具包技能合集
zh-CN.shortDesc: AWS 官方工具包中的 118 个技能，涵盖开发、部署、数据、安全与运维。仅安装技能指引；CLI/SDK、MCP、运行环境、账户与 IAM 权限需按所选技能另行配置，云资源及第三方服务可能收费；缺依赖时停止执行。

en-US.name: Agent Toolkit for AWS Skills
en-US.shortDesc: 118 skills from the AWS-maintained toolkit for development, deployment, data, security and operations. Instructions only: separately configure each skill’s CLI/SDK, MCP, runtime, account and IAM access. Cloud resources and external services may incur charges; stop when prerequisites are missing.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 在 Amazon Bedrock 上构建生成式 AI 应用，涵盖模型调用、RAG、知识库、Agents 与 AgentCore。

en-US.shortDesc: Build generative AI applications on Amazon Bedrock, including model invocation, RAG, Knowledge Bases, Agents and AgentCore.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 使用 Amazon SageMaker 选择、训练、定制、评估和部署 AI 模型，排查推理端点问题。

en-US.shortDesc: Select, train, customize, evaluate and deploy AI models on Amazon SageMaker; diagnose inference endpoints.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 通过 Amazon Cognito 与 Amplify 身份验证库，为 Web 和移动应用添加注册、登录及访问控制。

en-US.shortDesc: Add sign-up, sign-in and access control to web and mobile apps with Amazon Cognito and Amplify auth libraries.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 分析 AWS 账单、预算和成本异常，评估 Savings Plans、预留实例及资源规格优化。

en-US.shortDesc: Analyze AWS bills, budgets and cost anomalies; evaluate Savings Plans, Reserved Instances and resource right-sizing.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 使用 AWS Blocks 的 Infrastructure-from-Code 模式构建、调试和部署全栈应用。

en-US.shortDesc: Build, debug and deploy full-stack applications with the Infrastructure-from-Code framework AWS Blocks.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 使用 TypeScript 或 Python 编写、部署和排查 AWS CDK 基础设施与堆栈。

en-US.shortDesc: Author, deploy and troubleshoot AWS CDK infrastructure and stacks in TypeScript or Python.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 编写、验证和排查 CloudFormation 模板，结合安全检查与堆栈事件诊断部署问题。

en-US.shortDesc: Author, validate and troubleshoot CloudFormation templates using security checks and stack-event diagnostics.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 选择和运维 EC2 实例，配置 Auto Scaling、启动模板、AMI、Spot 与 Systems Manager。

en-US.shortDesc: Select and operate EC2 instances; configure Auto Scaling, launch templates, AMIs, Spot and Systems Manager.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 使用 EKS、ECS、Fargate 与 ECR 构建和部署容器工作负载。

en-US.shortDesc: Build and deploy containerized workloads with EKS, ECS, Fargate and ECR.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 根据选型、对比、入门或运维需求，将 AWS 数据库任务分派到对应服务技能。

en-US.shortDesc: Route AWS database selection, comparison, onboarding and operational tasks to the appropriate service skill.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 使用 CodePipeline、CodeBuild、CodeDeploy、CodeConnections 与 CodeArtifact 配置 CI/CD。

en-US.shortDesc: Configure CI/CD with CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CodeConnections and CodeArtifact.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 核对 IAM 策略求值、信任策略、STS 会话和 Organizations 等容易误判的权限行为。

en-US.shortDesc: Check commonly misunderstood IAM policy evaluation, trust policies, STS sessions and Organizations behavior.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 指导 AWS 消息与流服务的选用和一般操作。

en-US.shortDesc: Guide service selection and general operations for AWS messaging and streaming.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 将 AWS 网络需求分派到相应服务技能，指导后续配置。

en-US.shortDesc: Route AWS networking requirements to the appropriate service skill for implementation.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 构建、配置和排查 AWS 可观测性方案，区分 CloudWatch Omni 与经典工作流。

en-US.shortDesc: Build, configure and troubleshoot AWS observability, distinguishing CloudWatch Omni from classic workflows.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 指导 AWS SDK for JavaScript v3 的开发模式、依赖和版本要求。

en-US.shortDesc: Guide AWS SDK for JavaScript v3 development patterns, dependencies and version requirements.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 指导 AWS SDK for Python（boto3/botocore）的开发模式。

en-US.shortDesc: Guide AWS SDK for Python development patterns with boto3 and botocore.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 指导 AWS SDK for Swift 的开发模式。

en-US.shortDesc: Guide AWS SDK for Swift development patterns.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 评估 AWS 安全服务的适用性、覆盖范围和费用，包括 WAF、Network Firewall 与 VPC 端点。

en-US.shortDesc: Assess AWS security service suitability, coverage and costs, including WAF, Network Firewall and VPC endpoints.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 根据需求选择无服务器计算形态，并分派到负责该形态的技能。

en-US.shortDesc: Select a serverless compute form factor and route the request to its owning skill.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 比较 AWS 对象、文件和块存储，分析成本、性能、配置、安全与故障。

en-US.shortDesc: Compare AWS object, file and block storage; investigate cost, performance, configuration, security and failures.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 依据在线框架文档，跨支柱检查 AWS 工作负载的 Well-Architected 问题。

en-US.shortDesc: Review AWS workloads across Well-Architected pillars using questions discovered from live framework documentation.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 指导将快速原型 Web 应用迁移到 AWS。

en-US.shortDesc: Guide migration of prototype web applications to AWS.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 通过 aws login 获取 CLI/SDK 凭据；该登录流程要求 AWS CLI 2.32.0 或更高版本。

en-US.shortDesc: Obtain CLI/SDK credentials through aws login; this login flow requires AWS CLI 2.32.0 or later.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 指导 Amazon OpenSearch 的迁移、配置、搜索、日志与链路分析，以及 Agentic AI Assistant 工作流。

en-US.shortDesc: Guide Amazon OpenSearch migration, provisioning, search, log and trace analytics, and Agentic AI Assistant workflows.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 为 Amazon MWAA 编写和部署 Airflow Python DAG 或 Serverless YAML 工作流。

en-US.shortDesc: Author and deploy Airflow Python DAGs or Serverless YAML workflows for Amazon MWAA.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 排查 AWS Clean Rooms 协作中的 IAM、S3、KMS、Lake Formation 权限与日志问题。

en-US.shortDesc: Troubleshoot AWS Clean Rooms collaboration issues involving IAM, S3, KMS, Lake Formation and logs.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 创建和排查 AWS Glue 到 JDBC 数据库、Redshift、Snowflake 或 BigQuery 的连接。

en-US.shortDesc: Create and troubleshoot AWS Glue connections to JDBC databases, Redshift, Snowflake and BigQuery.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 诊断 Amazon MWAA Provisioned 与 Serverless 工作流失败的根因。

en-US.shortDesc: Diagnose Amazon MWAA Provisioned and Serverless workflow failures.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 指导 Flink 与 Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink 应用开发。

en-US.shortDesc: Guide application development with Flink and Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 盘点和审计 AWS Glue Data Catalog 中的 S3 Tables、Redshift 联合目录及远程 Iceberg 资产。

en-US.shortDesc: Inventory and audit AWS Glue Data Catalog assets across S3 Tables, Redshift-federated and remote Iceberg catalogs.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 在 Glue Data Catalog、S3、S3 Tables 与 Redshift 中定位数据湖和湖仓资产。

en-US.shortDesc: Locate data lake and lakehouse assets across Glue Data Catalog, S3, S3 Tables and Redshift.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 将文件或数据库数据导入 AWS 数据湖，支持 JDBC、Redshift、Snowflake 等来源。

en-US.shortDesc: Import files and database data into the AWS data lake from JDBC databases, Redshift, Snowflake and other sources.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 运维 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams，核对流模式、目标、区域与 IAM 前置条件。

en-US.shortDesc: Operate Amazon Kinesis Data Streams and check stream mode, destinations, Region and IAM prerequisites.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 运维 Amazon MSK Provisioned 集群，包括 Standard 与 Express broker。

en-US.shortDesc: Operate Amazon MSK Provisioned clusters with Standard or Express brokers.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 通过 SageMaker Catalog（DataZone）订阅流程授予、申请、审计和移除数据资产访问权限。

en-US.shortDesc: Grant, request, audit and remove data asset access through SageMaker Catalog (DataZone) subscriptions.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 维护 SageMaker Catalog（DataZone）或 Glue Data Catalog 中的业务元数据。

en-US.shortDesc: Write and curate business metadata in SageMaker Catalog (DataZone) or Glue Data Catalog.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 评估并迁移自建 Apache Kafka 工作负载到 Amazon MSK Express。

en-US.shortDesc: Assess and migrate self-managed Apache Kafka workloads to Amazon MSK Express.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 指导数据仓库迁移到 Redshift，涵盖发现、SQL/模式转换、数据迁移、验证与性能调优。

en-US.shortDesc: Guide data warehouse migration to Redshift: discovery, SQL/schema conversion, data migration, validation and tuning.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 通过 Athena SQL 查询和管理 Glue、S3 Tables、Redshift 等默认或联合目录中的数据。

en-US.shortDesc: Run and manage Athena SQL queries across default and federated catalogs, including Glue, S3 Tables and Redshift.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 指导 Redshift SQL、元数据、连接认证、存储、性能与运维，避免套用 PostgreSQL 假设。

en-US.shortDesc: Guide Redshift SQL, metadata, connectivity, authentication, storage, performance and operations without assuming PostgreSQL behavior.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 触发 Amazon MWAA 工作流并监控至完成，检查 Provisioned 与 Serverless 的端到端执行。

en-US.shortDesc: Trigger and monitor Amazon MWAA workflows to completion for Provisioned and Serverless end-to-end execution checks.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 升级 MWAA 的 Airflow 版本，涵盖同系列升级及从 2.x 到 3.x 的迁移。

en-US.shortDesc: Upgrade MWAA Airflow environments within a release series or across the 2.x-to-3.x boundary.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 部署、查询和排查 AWS Marketplace 按量计费的用量计量集成。

en-US.shortDesc: Deploy, query and troubleshoot usage-based metering integrations for AWS Marketplace.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 指导 Amazon SES 域名邮件发送的接入流程。

en-US.shortDesc: Guide onboarding for domain-based email sending with Amazon SES.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 通过 pinpoint-sms-voice-v2 CLI 接入 RCS Business Messaging 与 Notify OTP。

en-US.shortDesc: Onboard RCS Business Messaging and Notify OTP through the pinpoint-sms-voice-v2 CLI.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 通过 AWS End User Messaging Social 管理 WhatsApp 消息。

en-US.shortDesc: Manage WhatsApp messaging through AWS End User Messaging Social.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 创建、修改和运维 Aurora MySQL 集群，涵盖 Serverless 与并行查询。

en-US.shortDesc: Create, modify and operate Aurora MySQL clusters, including Serverless and parallel query.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 创建、修改和运维 Aurora PostgreSQL 集群，包括 Serverless 等引擎特性。

en-US.shortDesc: Create, modify and operate Aurora PostgreSQL clusters, including Serverless and other engine-specific features.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 指导 DocumentDB 集群、TLS/VPC/驱动配置、文档与向量建模及 MongoDB 兼容性。

en-US.shortDesc: Guide DocumentDB clusters, TLS/VPC/driver configuration, document and vector modeling, and MongoDB compatibility.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 根据访问模式设计和审查 DynamoDB 数据层，选择主键、GSI 与单表或多表方案。

en-US.shortDesc: Design and review DynamoDB data layers from access patterns, choosing keys, GSIs and single-table or multi-table designs.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 识别缓存需求，评估和配置 ElastiCache，以处理应用延迟、数据库瓶颈与成本压力。

en-US.shortDesc: Identify caching needs and configure ElastiCache for application latency, database bottlenecks and cost pressure.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 核对 Amazon Keyspaces 兼容性、价格、连接与预热方案；部分脚本另需 Node.js 和 npm 依赖。

en-US.shortDesc: Check Amazon Keyspaces compatibility, pricing, connectivity and pre-warming; some scripts need Node.js and npm dependencies.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 指导 Neptune Database 与 Neptune Analytics 的图数据库、知识图谱及关系分析工作负载。

en-US.shortDesc: Guide graph, knowledge-graph and relationship analytics workloads on Neptune Database and Neptune Analytics.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 配置和连接 Aurora DSQL，管理模式、执行查询、迁移 MySQL 并诊断执行计划。

en-US.shortDesc: Provision and connect to Aurora DSQL, manage schemas, run queries, migrate MySQL and diagnose query plans.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 按顺序创建 Aurora 数据库集群和实例，并通过 Secrets Manager 管理密码。

en-US.shortDesc: Create an Aurora database cluster and instances in order, with Secrets Manager password management.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 将 RDS 或 Aurora 快照以 Apache Parquet 格式导出到 S3，用于分析、备份或迁移。

en-US.shortDesc: Export RDS or Aurora snapshots to S3 in Apache Parquet format for analytics, backup or migration.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 指导 RDS for Db2 的配置、连接、迁移和运维。

en-US.shortDesc: Guide provisioning, connectivity, migration and operations for RDS for Db2.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 诊断 RDS for Oracle 的连接、身份验证、网络与驱动问题。

en-US.shortDesc: Diagnose RDS for Oracle connectivity, authentication, networking and driver issues.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 指导 RDS 开源引擎的实例创建、升级、承诺定价、代理评估与蓝绿部署。

en-US.shortDesc: Guide RDS open-source engine provisioning, upgrades, commitment pricing, proxy evaluation and blue/green deployments.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 指导 RDS for SQL Server 的连接、身份验证与故障排查。

en-US.shortDesc: Guide connectivity, authentication and troubleshooting for RDS for SQL Server.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 按引擎版本核对 Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB 的使用与运维指引。

en-US.shortDesc: Retrieve engine-specific usage and operational guidance for Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 使用 EC2 Image Builder 自动构建 Linux、Windows、macOS AMI 及 ECR 容器镜像。

en-US.shortDesc: Automate Linux, Windows and macOS AMI builds and ECR container images with EC2 Image Builder.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 采用安全和成本意识的默认配置启动 EC2，包括 AMI、实例规格、IAM 与安全组。

en-US.shortDesc: Launch EC2 instances with security- and cost-conscious AMI, sizing, IAM and security group defaults.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 创建并绑定 IAM 实例配置文件，使 EC2 无需硬编码凭据即可访问 AWS 服务。

en-US.shortDesc: Create and attach IAM instance profiles so EC2 can access AWS services without hardcoded credentials.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 通过另行配置的 Agent Access MCP，将 AI Agent 接入 WorkSpaces Applications 的远程 Windows 应用。

en-US.shortDesc: Connect AI agents to remote Windows apps in WorkSpaces Applications through a separately configured Agent Access MCP server.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 使用另行安装的 AWS Transform（ATX）CLI 执行代码升级、迁移与转换。

en-US.shortDesc: Upgrade, migrate and transform code with the separately installed AWS Transform (ATX) CLI.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 管理 DMS Schema Conversion 的迁移项目、数据库模式转换与兼容性评估流程。

en-US.shortDesc: Manage DMS Schema Conversion migration projects, database schema conversion and compatibility assessments.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 配置 CloudFront 内容分发，处理缓存、源站、边缘计算与相关安全服务集成。

en-US.shortDesc: Configure CloudFront content delivery, caching, origins, edge compute and related security integrations.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 通过 PrivateLink 配置接口型和网关型 VPC 端点，以私有方式访问 AWS 服务。

en-US.shortDesc: Configure interface and gateway VPC endpoints for private AWS service access with PrivateLink.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 建立两个 VPC 之间的对等连接，配置直接私有网络互通。

en-US.shortDesc: Establish VPC peering for direct private connectivity between two VPCs.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 创建多可用区 VPC，包括公私子网、互联网网关、NAT 网关、路由与安全配置。

en-US.shortDesc: Create a multi-AZ VPC with public/private subnets, internet and NAT gateways, routing and security configuration.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 配置 Direct Connect 的连接模式、交叉连接、虚拟接口与混合网络连接。

en-US.shortDesc: Configure Direct Connect connection models, cross connects, virtual interfaces and hybrid connectivity.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 通过 NAT 网关、公私子网路由与安全组，让 VPC 内的 Lambda 访问互联网。

en-US.shortDesc: Enable internet access for VPC-connected Lambda through NAT gateways, subnet routing and security groups.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 配置 Route 53 DNS、路由策略、健康检查、DNS Firewall、Profiles 与 VPC Resolver。

en-US.shortDesc: Configure Route 53 DNS, routing policies, health checks, DNS Firewall, Profiles and VPC Resolver.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 配置 Route 53，将自定义域名的流量路由到 CloudFront 分发。

en-US.shortDesc: Configure Route 53 to route a custom domain to a CloudFront distribution.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 配置 Shield Advanced 的 DDoS 防护、资源保护与自动响应；订阅和服务费用另计。

en-US.shortDesc: Configure Shield Advanced DDoS protection and automated response; subscription and service charges apply separately.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 配置本地网络与 VPC 之间的 Site-to-Site IPsec VPN，并选择目标网关。

en-US.shortDesc: Configure Site-to-Site IPsec VPN between an on-premises network and a VPC, selecting the target gateway.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 配置 Transit Gateway、VPC 附件与路由表，实现网络分段、集中出口和流量检查。

en-US.shortDesc: Configure Transit Gateway, VPC attachments and route tables for segmentation, centralized egress and inspection.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 在 CloudFront、ALB、API Gateway 或 AppSync 上配置 WAF Web ACL 以过滤流量。

en-US.shortDesc: Configure WAF web ACLs on CloudFront, ALB, API Gateway or AppSync to filter web traffic.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 安装、配置和排查 EC2 上的 Network Flow Monitor Agent，监测网络路径健康状况。

en-US.shortDesc: Install, configure and troubleshoot Network Flow Monitor agents on EC2 to monitor network path health.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 配置多区域 CloudTrail、S3 日志与 CloudWatch 集成，用于审计和安全监控。

en-US.shortDesc: Configure multi-Region CloudTrail, S3 logs and CloudWatch integration for auditing and security monitoring.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 通过 SNS 主题与订阅配置 CloudWatch 告警通知渠道。

en-US.shortDesc: Configure CloudWatch alarm notification channels with SNS topics and subscriptions.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 首次设置 CloudWatch Omni 应用可观测性或经典 CloudWatch 方案。

en-US.shortDesc: Set up CloudWatch Omni application observability or classic CloudWatch for the first time.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 发现并分析 CloudWatch 日志组，定位应用故障模式、根因和修复措施。

en-US.shortDesc: Discover and analyze CloudWatch log groups to identify application failure patterns, root causes and fixes.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 通过 Amazon Braket 发现量子设备与模拟器，构建并运行量子计算工作流。

en-US.shortDesc: Discover quantum devices and simulators and build and run quantum computing workflows with Amazon Braket.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 指导 ARC Region switch 的架构、计划、执行块、工作流和触发条件。

en-US.shortDesc: Guide ARC Region switch architecture, plans, execution blocks, workflows and triggers.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 规划、运行和分析 AWS FIS 故障注入实验，验证应用韧性；需事先确认影响范围。

en-US.shortDesc: Plan, run and analyze AWS FIS experiments to validate application resilience; confirm the impact scope first.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 结合 Resilience Hub、FIS 与 ARC，指导 AWS 韧性评估、修复和验证流程。

en-US.shortDesc: Guide AWS resilience assessment, remediation and validation with Resilience Hub, FIS and ARC.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 配置 ARC 路由控制、安全规则及可用区转移，以支持故障恢复。

en-US.shortDesc: Configure ARC routing controls, safety rules and zonal shift for operational recovery.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 运行和解读 Resilience Hub v2 的故障模式评估。

en-US.shortDesc: Run and interpret Resilience Hub v2 failure mode assessments.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 从零设置 Resilience Hub v2，包括韧性策略、SLO、系统、用户旅程与服务接入。

en-US.shortDesc: Set up Resilience Hub v2 policies, SLOs, systems, user journeys and service onboarding from scratch.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 配置 Resilience Hub v2 的跨账户 IAM 权限与集中评估。

en-US.shortDesc: Configure cross-account IAM permissions and centralized assessment for Resilience Hub v2.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 设计组织级韧性计划，包括分层策略、可用性/RTO/RPO 目标、灾备方案和演练频率。

en-US.shortDesc: Design organization-wide resilience policies, availability/RTO/RPO targets, disaster recovery approaches and exercise cadence.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 通过 Secrets Manager 创建和管理密钥，配置 KMS、轮换、最小权限及审计。

en-US.shortDesc: Create and manage Secrets Manager secrets with KMS, rotation, least privilege and auditing.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 使用 EventBridge Event Bus 构建和运维事件驱动应用，支持发布订阅、解耦及治理。

en-US.shortDesc: Build and operate event-driven applications with EventBridge Event Bus for publish/subscribe, decoupling and governance.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 使用 Lambda durable functions 构建长时多步骤应用，处理状态持久化、重试、回放与回调。

en-US.shortDesc: Build long-running, multi-step apps with Lambda durable functions, state persistence, retries, replay and callbacks.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 评估、配置并迁移到 Lambda Managed Instances，在用户账户的 EC2 上运行 Lambda。

en-US.shortDesc: Evaluate, configure and migrate to Lambda Managed Instances running Lambda on EC2 in the user's account.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 使用 Lambda MicroVMs 构建和运维隔离、可快照恢复的无服务器执行环境。

en-US.shortDesc: Build and operate isolated, snapshot-resumable serverless execution environments with Lambda MicroVMs.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 使用 Lambda Web Functions 构建、打包和部署 Node.js HTTP 应用与 API。

en-US.shortDesc: Build, package and deploy Node.js HTTP apps and APIs with Lambda Web Functions.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 编写和调试 Step Functions 状态机，处理 JSONata、分支、重试、服务集成与人工审批回调。

en-US.shortDesc: Author and debug Step Functions state machines with JSONata, branching, retries, service integrations and approval callbacks.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 将 Lambda 接入 API Gateway，配置代理集成、权限、CORS、限流与部署。
